title: Decolonisation of Africa
summary: The period in which the colonial governments formed during the Scramble for Africa gave way to sovereign states. The span is the one the cited article states and no other: "between the mid-1950s to 1976". The end is a year the article gives; the start is not, so it is written as the range 1954-1956 that "mid-1950s" names rather than as a year nobody wrote down, and the containment test reads the early end of that range. Nothing here is this atlas's account of the period: it is an umbrella, which is a display fact and not an argument, and review.html is where somebody writes the account.
regionNote: Africa is the period's own subject, so the lane is the article's and not a derivation: this event points at no place record and a continent has no point.
